title: 1993 Russia 100 Rubles Banknote P-254 Russian Federation Circulated Currency
descriptionText:
Condition Description:
Original circulated 1993 Russian 100 Rubles banknote. Shows significant handling and age-related wear, including multiple folds and creases, discoloration/toning, edge wear, and general surface wear. No grading has been assigned. Please review all photos carefully for the exact condition of the note you will receive.

Item Specifics:

* Country: Russia
* Country of Origin: Russian Federation
* Year: 1993
* Denomination: 100 Rubles
* Type: Banknote
* Pick Number: P-254
* Circulated/Uncirculated: Circulated
* Grade: Ungraded
* Certification: Uncertified
* Composition: Paper
* Serial Number: ЭМ 9805296
* Era: Russian Federation

Description:
Original 1993 Bank of Russia 100 Rubles banknote featuring the Moscow Kremlin and Russian tricolor flag.

This is the P-254 issue from the early Russian Federation period following the dissolution of the Soviet Union. The reverse features a detailed view of the Kremlin and Spasskaya Tower.

The note is in well-circulated condition with visible folds, creasing, toning, staining/discoloration, edge and corner wear, and other signs of age and handling. It remains intact and displays well as an inexpensive piece of post-Soviet Russian currency.

Serial number: ЭМ 9805296

The banknote shown in the photos is the exact item you will receive. Please examine all photos closely as they are part of the condition description.
